form:FormGroup.label: Record Limit
form:FormGroup.helpText: Maximum number of records (events) to process before processing of the search results stops. Enter 1 to 1,000,000,000. Default is 1,000,000 unless changed in the system configuration.

form:FormGroup.label: Time Limit (mins)
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of minutes, from the time processing is started, after which no more search results are processed. Enter 1 to 1,440. Default is 30 unless changed in the system configuration.
